entries.title: The Bridge
entries.background: An original score cue from Act 1 of Arcane's first season (episodes 1–3): track 1 of 29 on the Act 1 score album, one of three score albums Riot Games released, one per act, in November 2021. The hybrid orchestral and electronic score was written by Alexander Temple and Alex Seaver (Mako) with collaborators including Cameron Stone, Adam Michalak and Jett Galindo. The cue features violinist Ray Chen. It opens the Act 1 album.
